description: This file defines an abstract base class for rendering various chart types using the JPGraph library within the PhpSpreadsheet project. It manages chart rendering logic, different plot configurations, and supports multiple chart types such as pie, bar, line, scatter, radar, stock, contour, and more, depending on the chart's specification.

classes.name: JpGraphRendererBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing a framework for rendering charts using JPGraph, supporting diverse chart types and configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a given Chart object and sets up marker sets.

methods.name: formatPointMarker
methods.description: Configures the marker type and color for a data series plot.

methods.name: formatDataSetLabels
methods.description: Formats dataset labels according to chart's category format codes and rotation.

methods.name: percentageSumCalculation
methods.description: Calculates the sum of data values across series in a group for percentage calculations.

methods.name: percentageAdjustValues
methods.description: Adjusts data series values to percentages based on total sums.

methods.name: getCaption
methods.description: Retrieves the caption string from title or label elements.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Sets the chart’s title on the graph.

methods.name: renderLegend
methods.description: Sets or hides the chart legend based on chart configuration.

methods.name: renderCartesianPlotArea
methods.description: Initializes a Cartesian plot area with axes depending on chart type.

methods.name: renderPiePlotArea
methods.description: Initializes a pie chart plot area.

methods.name: renderRadarPlotArea
methods.description: Initializes a radar chart plot area.

methods.name: renderPlotLine
methods.description: Renders a line plot for a data group, possibly filled or for a combination chart.

methods.name: renderPlotBar
methods.description: Renders a bar chart group, handling orientations and 3D effects.

methods.name: renderPlotScatter
methods.description: Renders scatter and bubble plots with optional line and size adjustments.

methods.name: renderPlotRadar
methods.description: Renders a radar plot for a data group.

methods.name: renderPlotContour
methods.description: Renders contour (heatmap) plots for a group.

methods.name: renderPlotStock
methods.description: Renders stock (OHLC) plot with layered data points.

methods.name: renderAreaChart
methods.description: Renders an area chart with multiple groups.

methods.name: renderLineChart
methods.description: Renders a line chart with multiple groups.

methods.name: renderBarChart
methods.description: Renders a bar chart with multiple groups and options for 2D/3D.

methods.name: renderScatterChart
methods.description: Renders a scatter chart with multiple groups.

methods.name: renderBubbleChart
methods.description: Renders a bubble chart with multiple groups.

methods.name: renderPieChart
methods.description: Renders a pie or doughnut chart, possibly multiple pie plots for different groups.

methods.name: renderRadarChart
methods.description: Renders a radar chart with multiple data groups.

methods.name: renderStockChart
methods.description: Renders a stock (financial OHLC) chart.

methods.name: renderContourChart
methods.description: Renders contour plots.

methods.name: renderCombinationChart
methods.description: Renders a combined chart with different plot types in one graph.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to determine chart type and render accordingly, producing the output image.
